# jsQR 1.4.0

Upstream: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

This is the unmodified distribution `dist/jsQR.js`, renamed to `.cjs` for Vite's CommonJS handling. It is loaded only when scanning a QR code. The accompanying Apache-2.0 license is preserved in LICENSE.

Reused from the existing local Homeland-saas dependency. No CDN or network request is needed to decode identity data. Review upstream security and browser support before updating the distribution.
